entries.rationale: The source directly combines union, intersection, and complements over a finite universe; a U-bounded two-set region view exposes the decisive symmetric-difference membership structure.

The source is a finite-subset count driven by complement relations, an element-sum inequality, and odd cardinality; it supplies no stable region, interval, or concrete forced/forbidden/free partition that a visual would clarify.

The explicit source sets partition U into elements forced into X (A), forbidden from X (B), and free elements U minus (A union B); that forced/forbidden/free bucket is the decisive counting structure.
